title: Nightly market-data manifest training on Kaggle CPU kernels (submit-and-exit), VM cycle skips them; design phases 2-4
note: From FREE-CAPACITY-PLAN (a). MEASURED (trainer-vm-diag #23583, training_cycle.jsonl 10-30..11-05): primary cycle trains 67 manifests nightly, 31-33 min wall of training after a 18-44 min dataset phase; ict-trainer total 7.96 CPU-h in 6.75 d (34% of trainer CPU). Design: docs/plans/KAGGLE-TRAINING-PIPELINE-DESIGN-2026-10-13.md phases 2-4 (parity proven for the LightGBM class on kaggle_cpu only, KAGGLE-TRAIN-RUNNER-FIRST; HMM/RegimeClassifier/regression need their own parity unit). Return path exists: ml/offload-inbox + drain_inbox.py (single writer on the trainer). Tier 2: arming the drain for same-id registration and making the VM cycle skip offloaded manifests. The 10 OURS-data manifests stay on the trainer. Done when: N nights with the market manifests trained off-VM, registered via the drain, and the trainer's ict-trainer CPU-h/day falls by the measured share.
